entries.title: Psalms 129:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: From my youth - From the time that I was a people.

entries.title: Psalms 129:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Righteous - Faithful or merciful. The cords - Wherewith the plow was drawn. By these cords he understands all their plots and endeavours.

entries.title: Psalms 129:6
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: House - tops - Which there were flat. Which - Having no deep root, never comes to maturity. And so all their designs shall be abortive.

entries.title: Psalms 129:8–130:2
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The blessing - Which was an usual salutation given by passengers to reapers: so the meaning is, it never continues 'till the harvest comes.
